commands.name: search-artworks
commands.summary: Full-text search of the collection's artworks, with optional filters (public domain, on view, department, artist id), sort by date and pagination

commands.name: facet-artworks
commands.summary: Get facet counts (aggregation buckets) over the whole artwork collection for a keyword field such as department, classification or artist

commands.name: get-artwork
commands.summary: Get full details of one artwork by numeric id (title, artist, date, medium, dimensions, credit line, gallery, description, image id)

commands.name: get-artworks
commands.summary: Fetch several artworks at once by a comma-separated list of ids

commands.name: get-artwork-manifest
commands.summary: Get the IIIF Presentation manifest for an artwork (image service URLs, label, metadata)

commands.name: search-artists
commands.summary: Search artists by name. The returned id works with get-artist and the artist_id filter of search-artworks.

commands.name: get-artist
commands.summary: Get details of one artist by id (name, alternate names, birth and death dates, biography)

commands.name: search-exhibitions
commands.summary: Search museum exhibitions (current and past) by keyword

commands.name: get-exhibition
commands.summary: Get details of one exhibition by id (dates, gallery, description, artworks shown)

commands.name: search-events
commands.summary: Search museum events (tours, talks, programs) by keyword

commands.name: search-articles
commands.summary: Search the museum's editorial articles by keyword

commands.name: search-category-terms
commands.summary: Search category terms (styles, subjects, themes, classifications, materials, techniques, departments)

dropped.name: get-related-artworks
dropped.reason: The endpoint returns its data as an HTML fragment inside a JSON 'html' string. clify cannot run selectors on HTML embedded in JSON, so no structured fields can be extracted. search-artworks and get-artworks cover lookups.

dropped.name: autocomplete
dropped.reason: HTTP 403: this endpoint needs a login or the site refused the request. (HTTP 403)
